Verifiers SHALL require subscriber-chosen memorized secrets to be at least 8 characters in length. Verifiers SHOULD permit subscriber-chosen memorized secrets at least 64 characters in length. All printing ASCII characters as well as the space character SHOULD be acceptable in memorized secrets. Unicode characters SHOULD be accepted as well.

Verifiers SHOULD NOT impose other composition rules (for example, requiring mixtures of different character types) on memorized secrets. Verifiers SHOULD NOT require memorized secrets to be changed arbitrarily (for example, periodically). However, verifiers SHALL force a change if there is evidence of compromise of the authenticator.
